newsitem.title: USA: Maxxim Medical adopts holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Maxxim Medical adopts holder rights plan.

text.p: Maxxim Medical Inc said its board has adopted a shareholder rights plan intended to assure that shareholders would receive fair treatment if there were any proposed takeover of the company.
The plan also aims to guard against any partial tender offers and other abusive tactics to gain control of the company without paying shareholders fair value for their holdings, it said.
Under the plan, the company said it has declared a dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right on each outstanding common share.
Each right entitles the holder to buy one one-thousandth of a share of the company's participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $85, it said.

The rights will be triggered after the tenth day that a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of the company's outstanding common stock or announces a tender offer completion of which will result in the person or group holding a stake of 15 percent of more 15 percent.
